text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has felt rewarding, but a gain relative to my purchase price does not tell me whether selling is best; judge each trade by its future prospects and the portfolio as a whole.","A loss feels especially painful, but my average cost is not a reason to keep holding; reassess losing positions by the same standards as winners.","Recent price changes do not predict what comes next, so avoid reacting to short-term moves and keep diversification and risk in view."]}
